_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

drop-media.text: Choose a photo, a burst, or a video to begin.

job-running.text: The job view shows each stage as the engine you choose builds the scene.

close.text: Turn a photo into a place with Photo Time Machine. Visit ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.

plate-to-space.text: A single photo can become a 3D memory you can orbit and revisit.

whose-hardware.text: Finished scenes land in your gallery, ready to open again.

from-memory.text: Connect Companion Memory and the finished scene can appear beside the rest of your history.

stays-yours.text: Keep the 3D file on hardware you control, and create a link only when you choose to share.
